data.review_body:
Order numbers:
GSU18C04R00N85K and GSU18C04R00N85J

So after weeks of Shein denying my refund for a misdelivered order they waited till I came here on trust pilot to publicly exposed them for being scammers to finally refund me even after blatantly denying my physical letter from the post office. But Here is where the real scam beings! Mind you this is a joint package do you know that shein deliberately only refunded 2 cheap orders to my original payment and then put the rest to the shein wallet??? I specifically asked that the money be put to my original payment method!!! They thought I wouldn't notice I immediatly contacted them to fix the issue and they proceeded to lie to my face and say "sorry once we issue a refund we can't refund you again" so in other words after we scam you we will still disrespect you and keep your money on our websites wallet instead of fully refunding you like you requested!!! At this point I will call my bank and report this transaction for fraud as this is what it boils down to now. You tried to scam me twice I'm not doing this again and also they only fix things for customers once they have been exposed on the better business bureau!!!
All items that I bought from Shein I was happy with, they came in good condition and is very affordable. Ideal for holiday clothes or special occasions. Easy ordering and easy returns if necessary.

data.review_body: SHEIN falsely advertised a nightgown as Natural Linen with no other fabric materials listed in the product description. When I returned the item because it was actually made of mostly synthetic fabrics, 67% Viscose (Rayon) and 24% Polyamide (Nylon) and only 8% Linen, SHEIN only issued a partial refund even though it was returned due their own misrepresentation of the product. SHEIN refused to address the issue with nonsensical/irrelevant responses to my demands for a full refund. SHEIN should first and foremost stop misrepresenting products and definitely should fully refund customers when they are called out for doing so.

data.review_body:
J'ai acheté une bague en mars 2025. Celle-ci est rapidement tombée en panne.
Je l'ai renvoyée et après plus de 100 messages d'échange, ils me disent avoir remboursé.
Or la carte initiale n'existe plus depuis juillet 2025.
La Banque Postale a confirmé, par écrit,  que jamais un remboursement n'avait été effectué, ni sur l'ancienne carte, ni sur la nouvelle et ALI ne répond plus et a bine menti et gardé l'argent, sinon celui-ci serait sur mon compte.
Je vais informer la DGCCRF mais je pense qu'ils sont blasés d'avoir autant de plaintes contre cette société.
Et bien sûr, ils vont répondre COMME à CHAQUE FOIS, que je suis un client prioritaire et qu'ils prennent en chargepour se couvrir au niveau de TRUSPILOT alors qu'ils ferment définitivement tous les recours.
ENGLISH
I bought a ring in March 2025. It quickly broke down.
I sent it back, and after an exchange of over 100 messages, they claim to have issued a refund.
However, the original card has not existed since July 2025.
La Banque Postale has confirmed in writing that no refund was ever made—neither to the old card nor the new one—and ALI has stopped responding; they clearly lied and kept the money, otherwise it would be in my account.
I am going to report this to the DGCCRF, though I imagine they are weary of the sheer number of complaints against this company.
And of course, they will reply—JUST LIKE EVERY TIME—saying I am a priority customer and that they are handling the matter (to cover themselves on Trustpilot), all while effectively shutting down every avenue for recourse.
